questions.question: Comment on the sources of contamination of milk.
questions.solution_html:
• Comment on the sources of contamination of milk.
  • Animal source – bacteria from the udder, skin, dung, and diseases of the animal.
  • Environment and equipment – contaminated water, air, utensils, milking machines, and handlers
  • during milking, processing, and storage.
  • Preservation methods such as pasteurization and refrigeration.
  • Protects public health from milk-borne diseases.
questions.final_answer: Protects public health from milk-borne diseases
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What are thermoduric bacteria, and what is their significance in pasteurized / milk?
questions.solution_html:
• Thermoduric bacteria are heat-resistant bacteria that can survive pasteurization temperatures. Their
  • significance in pasteurized milk is that they may reduce milk quality and shelf life, and some can cause
  • spoilage during storage.
questions.final_answer: spoilage during storage
